response.sql: SELECT tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist, AVG(sf.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(sf.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(sf.shortintrt) / (SELECT AVG(sf2.shortintrt) FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf2 JOIN transactionrecord tr2 ON sf2.transref = tr2.transreg WHERE tr2.ordertypedist = tr.ordertypedist) AS short_interest_ratio FROM transactionrecord tr INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON tr.transreg = sf.transref GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
